scope: Corollary 8.2 (Singer vanishing for semialgebraic covers) of the manuscript “Semialgebraic universal covers of normal projective varieties” (preprints/Semialgebraic-universal-covers-of-normal-projective-varieties-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 058 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dd294523779a9237), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a smooth connected closed aspherical projective complex n-fold whose ordinary universal cover has a semialgebraic projective- open presentation. Its L2-Betti numbers, computed from the reduced L2-cohomology of the universal cover, satisfy b (2) j (X) = 0 (j ≥ 0, j ̸= n). If m > 0 for the affine factor in the product constructed in the proof of Theorem 1.1, then b (2) j (X) = 0 for every j ≥ 0.
